text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — multi-GPU NCCL hang detected on cluster-gw-12 (tp4 jobs). Auto-escalation to oncall-ryan.

oncall-ryan: ack, I'm on it. joining bridge in 30s

sre-maya: i started a quick check, seeing repeated XID 79 in dmesg on node gpu-12-3

eng-runtime-lee: link to recent deploy? deploy-bot shows a model rollout 10m ago to tp4 runtime on that node.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T08:02:13Z — rollout model-v2-beta -> tp4-runtime (batch 4/8)

oncall-ryan: can someone dump the NCCL logs and dmesg here? pls paste `kubectl logs` output if possible

eng-runtime-lee: pastebin'd longer logs, but core snippet:
```
[ 9421.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 9421.123457] GPU-assert: driver reset
[ 9421.123500] containerd: container runtime exited with code 137
```

sre-maya: NCCL trace shows communicator wait on `ncclCommAllReduce` — rank 2 stuck, timeouts across all ranks. We see heavy CUDA memory pressure before the hang.

oncall-ryan: customer-impact? CS?

customer-success-jamie: two customers running long-running inference pipelines got ~5-10% request failures and elevated latency starting 08:02 UTC. internal CI job `tp4-smoke` failed 3/3.

sre-maya: immediate mitigation plan: (1) cordon node gpu-12-3, (2) drain pods with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`, (3) restart containerd on node and trigger GPU reset, (4) fallback affected requests to single-GPU model variant.

oncall-ryan: executing cordon/drain now

ops-bot: cordon: kubeadm cordon gpu-12-3 — success

oncall-ryan: drain started:
```
kubectl drain gpu-12-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

eng-runtime-lee: note — draining TP jobs will interrupt pipeline-parallel jobs; we need to ensure automatic restart uses model-v2-single instead of failing the request. Adding routing override.

sre-maya: after drain, I see containerd restart attempt failed, dmesg still shows repeated XID 79 during reset. Planning to reprovision node and run `nvidia-persistenced` kill/start and full node reboot if reset not successful.

oncall-ryan: going to rollback that model rollout batch 4/8 to reduce memory pressure cluster-wide. 

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for rollout id model-v2-beta (batch 4/8) by oncall-ryan

sre-maya: quick workaround applied: route 20% of traffic to model-v2-single and 80% to fallback older stable model-v1. That reduced collector errors.

customer-success-jamie: notified affected customers — sending status update with impact window and mitigation steps. Will attach postmortem link later.

oncall-olivia: I'm taking next shift at +30m for handoff. pls leave summary.

oncall-ryan: summary for handoff @oncall-olivia:
- root alarm: NCCL communicator hang during TP4 job on gpu-12-3 with repeated XID 79s
- impact: 2 customers partial failures, internal CI flakiness
- actions taken: cordon+drain node, rollback model rollout batch, route traffic to single-GPU/fallback models, attempted containerd restart, prepping node reprovision
- next steps: if node still shows XID79 after reboot, escalate to infra with possible kernel/driver rollback and hardware check, collect nvlink and PCIe error counts, gather full `kubelet` and `containerd` logs

sre-maya: logs to attach to ticket:
- `dmesg` snippet
- `kubectl describe pod` for all 4 TP pods
- `nccl_trace` output (tarball uploaded to S3 s3://redwood-incidents/4481234567/nccl_trace.tgz)

oncall-ryan: opening incident ticket INC-20260315-4481234567 and tagging infra, runtime, and customer success

ops-bot: INC-20260315-4481234567 created — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20260315-4481234567

eng-runtime-lee: while we wait on reprovision, quick diagnostic commands for hardware folks:
```
nvmlDeviceGetFieldValues -pciInfo -e eccErrors
nvidia-smi topo -m
lspci -vvv | grep -i nvlink -A3
```

sre-maya: note — observed one pod with `OOMKilled` earlier but core problem appears to be GPU reset (XID79) causing container and driver instability, which leads to NCCL hang rather than pure memory OOM.

customer-success-jamie: drafting customer note, will post in status page once node reprovision outcome is known. suggested language: "intermittent inference errors and latency spikes for subset of customers due to multi-GPU rendezvous failures; mitigation applied: traffic routed to single-GPU/fallback models."

oncall-olivia: taking over now. I'll keep the bridge open for 1h and coordinate hardware reprovision if needed. Thanks all.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager acknowledged by oncall-ryan; handoff complete to oncall-olivia at 08:32 UTC

end of thread.
